## Hinge question · Unit length, same direction {#iv4-hinge .vector-lesson .magnitude-lesson }

<div data-module="hinge" data-correct="3" class="hinge numeric-choices"><p class="hinge-question">Given <span data-math="\mathbf a=(2,-1,2)"></span>, which vector has magnitude <span data-math="1"></span> and points in the same direction as <span data-math="\mathbf a"></span>?</p><div class="hinge-toolbar"><div class="time" role="timer" aria-label="Time remaining">1:00</div><div class="toolbar"><label>Seconds <select class="timer-duration" aria-label="Question duration"><option>30</option><option>45</option><option selected>60</option><option>90</option><option>120</option></select></label><button class="timer-start primary">Start</button><button class="reset-question">Reset</button></div></div><div class="choices"><button class="choice" data-answer="1" aria-pressed="false"><b>1</b><span data-math="(2,-1,2)"></span></button><button class="choice" data-answer="2" aria-pressed="false"><b>2</b><span data-math="(\tfrac29,-\tfrac19,\tfrac29)"></span></button><button class="choice" data-answer="3" aria-pressed="false"><b>3</b><span data-math="(\tfrac23,-\tfrac13,\tfrac23)"></span></button><button class="choice" data-answer="4" aria-pressed="false"><b>4</b><span data-math="(-\tfrac23,\tfrac13,-\tfrac23)"></span></button></div><div class="hinge-bottom"><p>Fist on chest. Think quietly.<br>On “show”, hold up 1–4 fingers.</p><button class="reveal-answer primary">Reveal answer</button></div><div class="hinge-explanation" hidden><strong>3.</strong> <span data-math="|\mathbf a|=\sqrt{4+1+4}=3"></span>, so <span data-math="\widehat{\mathbf a}=\tfrac13\mathbf a=(\tfrac23,-\tfrac13,\tfrac23)"></span>.</div></div>


::: notes
Place after Example 4.9 and immediately before 4.10. Correct choice 3. Choice 1 leaves length 3 unchanged; choice 2 divides by the squared magnitude, leaving length 1/3; choice 4 is a unit vector in the opposite direction. Default 60 seconds with manual reveal; collect 1–4 fingers simultaneously on the teacher’s show cue. Ready: proceed to constructing a length-five vector. Divided: ask which choices have length one and which have the correct direction, then revote. Needs explanation: calculate the magnitude and identify the positive scale factor 1/3. Timer expiry never reveals the answer.
:::
